title: Door County Coastal Byway
direction: Starts at the south end of the mapped byway, runs up the Lake Michigan side to Sister Bay, then down the Green Bay side through the harbour villages. The tip of the peninsula is a side branch from Sister Bay.

stretches.title: The Lake Michigan side
stretches.line: The quieter, open-water side of the peninsula.

stretches.title: Lighthouse woods
stretches.line: Wooded miles between the two coasts, with Cana Island a short detour east.

stretches.title: Bay villages
stretches.line: Harbour villages close together along Green Bay, and Peninsula State Park between them.

stretches.title: Out to the tip
stretches.line: A side trip to the end of the peninsula.
